_comment: Component map — which key of which config takes which palette role.
_why: palette.json answers 'what colours exist and what do they mean'.
This file answers the question that actually comes first when you open a config:
'I am editing herdr — what do I take from the palette, and into which key?'
Without it that gets re-derived every time by copying whatever the neighbouring
config does, which is exactly how the theme drifted into three parallel
sub-palettes before 2026-07-26. A component is not migrated until it is listed here.
_how_to_use: 1. Find the component. Read `keys` — left side is the config's own key path,
right side is a path into palette.json.
2. Resolve each role there and write the value. Never pick a 'similar' hex.
3. If a key has no matching role, do NOT invent one locally — add the role to
palette.json first, then reference it here. Gaps are listed per component
in `_gaps` precisely so they get closed at the source.
4. `_findings` holds what was learned about the component itself — which keys it
actually accepts, which are dead. That knowledge is as easy to lose as a colour.
5. Roles may point at other roles: `role.ui.accent` -> `ramp.sage.bright` -> `#c4ddd2`.
Resolve RECURSIVELY until a literal (`#rrggbb` or `rgba(...)`), not one hop.

_status_values.migrated: keys resolved from the palette, verified live
_status_values.pending: map drafted, values not yet applied

_findings: Accepts 16 colour keys, not the catppuccin set its names suggest. Confirmed
empirically with `herdr config check` — the docs do not list them.
`surface_dim` is the 16th and was missed initially because it is not a
catppuccin-standard name; it drives the side panel, the inactive-pane
scrollbar track and popup menus. Confirmed live 2026-07-26.
`base`/`mantle` are NOT accepted — `config check` flags them and they have no
runtime effect. An external audit claimed upstream issue #1710 made config
check false-flag working keys; tested and disproved on this machine.
`surface0`/`surface1` are accepted but were confirmed to have no visible
effect anywhere — dead weight, candidates for removal rather than migration.
`accent` appears twice, in [theme.custom] and [ui]. Both must move together.
_gaps: theme.custom.surface0 / surface1 — accepted by the config parser but confirmed
to have no visible effect anywhere. Removing rather than mapping; there is no
role for a key that paints nothing.
_resolved_gaps: mauve -> ramp.sage.shade — the pilot's main finding. herdr uses five steps of
sage depth; the ramp had four below its accent, so a tier was added. Solved at
4.59:1 rather than adopting herdr's #4a8b6e, which sat at 4.31, under AA.
overlay0/overlay1/subtext0 -> ramp.stone.* — a whole family was missing: neutral
with a sage bias, for text that recedes without going cold. Values taken from
herdr unchanged, they already cleared AA.
surface_dim -> surface.terminal.lift — 1-2 units per channel apart, and the hue

_pending_components: waybar, ghostty, rofi, swaync, swayosd, zathura, yazi, starship, uosc, swayimg,
mpv, hyprlock, vscode, obsidian — migrated in configs but not yet mapped here.
Backfill as each is revisited; the map is what makes a migration checkable.
